title: 16825 - 16825/P0441/001089
models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Evaporative Emission (EVAP) Canister Purge Regulator Valve (N80) faulty/jammed
Evaporative Emission (EVAP) Canister Purge Solenoid Valve (N115) faulty/jammed
Pipes between Tank Breathing and Gaz Kelebeği Ünitesi leaky/blocked
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin:  Evaporative Emission (EVAP) Canister Purge Regulator Valve (N80)
Gerçekleştirin: Output Test
Kontrol edin:  Evaporative Emission (EVAP) Canister Purge Solenoid Valve (N115)

Kontrol edin:  Evaporative Emission (EVAP) Canister
Gerçekleştirin: Basic Setting
Kontrol edin:  Pipes between Tank Breathing and Gaz Kelebeği Ünitesi
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the NAR 1.8T Audi A4 1.8T Kontrol edin: TSB 24-08-78 or 2010268/3 or Pass-Thru equivalent TSB
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the NAR 1.8T VW Passat 1.8T Kontrol edin: TSB 01-09-09 or 2005554  or Pass-Thru equivalent TSB
Note: The Passat 26E5 or "R5" recall includes the same software update
Make sure the quick release lines for the N80 valve and vacuum line to LDP are not crossed.
This can also make the engine hard to start after filling up the fuel tank.
For the Tiguan with the 2.0T DGUE engine that has one or more of the following fault codes, please see TSB 054615 for possible ECM update and hardware update.
P0172, P0300, P0301, P0302,P0303, P0304, P0441, P0456, P060C, P2440 and/or P2450
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2019/MC-10162819-0001.pdf  NHTSA
For the 2013-2019 Jetta 1.4 engine that has one or more of the following fault codes, please see Tech Tip 01-19-06 (2056714/1) for info on N80 Purge Valve testing
P0441, P0442, P0455, P0456
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2019/MC-10166734-0001.pdf   NHTSA
